settings.sync.title: Sync between computers
settings.sync.description: Keep favourites, ratings, play statuses, categories, custom titles and playtime the same on each computer. Install folders, settings and store sign-ins stay on each one.
settings.sync.folder_hint: Pick a folder that Syncthing, Dropbox, Nextcloud, OneDrive or a network share keeps in sync. Irori adds an “Irori sync” folder inside it.

settings.field.default_wine_prefix_dir.h: Each Windows game gets its own prefix inside this folder.

settings.sunshine.description: Sunshine streams games from this computer to Moonlight on a phone, TV or another computer. Irori keeps your games among its applications, with their covers, and updates them as your library changes.
settings.sunshine.quit_hint: Quitting a game in Moonlight stops it in Irori, and its playtime counts as usual. What you set on a game in Sunshine, such as preparation commands, stays.
settings.requires.sunshine: Turn on “Add games to Sunshine” first

settings.field.sunshine_big_picture.help: An “Irori Big Picture” application opens Big Picture, to pick a game from the couch.
settings.field.panel_sunshine.label: Sunshine

settings.field.in_sunshine.label: List in Sunshine

settings.field.discord_presence.label: Show on Discord
settings.field.discord_presence.help: Show this game on Discord while it runs, when Discord Rich Presence is on in Irori’s settings.
settings.sunshine.found_apollo: Apollo is set up here, its web UI on port {port}
settings.sunshine.apollo_works: Apollo, Sunshine’s fork with virtual displays, works the same way.
settings.sunshine.apollo_session: Apollo keeps one sign-in at a time: when Irori signs in, its web UI in your browser asks you to sign in again. Irori keeps its sign-in between syncs, so this is rare.
settings.field.discord_rpc.help: Show the game you are playing on Discord, with its cover and how long you have been playing. Discord must be running on this computer.
settings.field.discord_rpc.label: Discord Rich Presence
settings.field.dlss_indicator.label: Show the DLSS indicator
settings.field.dlss_upgrade.label: Upgrade DLSS
settings.field.download_no_https.help: Useful with a caching proxy such as LanCache.

settings.field.dxvk_version.label: DXVK version
settings.field.eac_runtime.label: Easy Anti-Cheat runtime

settings.field.enable_wow64.label: WoW64 mode

settings.field.exit_to_tray.label: Close to tray
settings.field.fsr4_upgrade.label: Upgrade to FSR 4
settings.field.gamepad_initial_repeat_de: Milliseconds before a held button starts repeating (50–500).
settings.field.gamepad_repeat_delay.help: Milliseconds between repeats while a button is held (5–150).
settings.field.overlay.label: In-game overlay (beta)
settings.field.overlay.help: The controller’s Guide button over a game Irori started opens volume, screenshots, achievements and today’s note above the game, and holds the controller from the game while it is open. Guide + RB takes a screenshot and Guide + Up or Down changes the volume. Works best on Wayland desktops with layer-shell (KDE Plasma, sway, Hyprland, COSMIC).
settings.field.overlay.help_windows: The controller’s Guide button or Ctrl+Shift+O over a game Irori started opens volume, screenshots, achievements and today’s note above the game. The game also sees the controller’s presses while it is open. Windows keeps the Xbox controller’s Guide button for the Xbox Game Bar, so use Ctrl+Shift+O there. Games in exclusive fullscreen can’t be covered: switch them to borderless.
settings.field.overlay.help_macos: The controller’s Guide button or Control+Shift+O over a game Irori started opens volume, screenshots, achievements and today’s note above the game. The game also sees the controller’s presses while it is open, and only the system volume can be changed. Screenshots need the Screen Recording permission, asked for the first time.
settings.field.gamescope_enable_force_gr: Keep the cursor in the window
settings.field.gamescope_enable_upscalin: Render at a lower resolution and let gamescope upscale. Gamescope must be installed.
settings.field.gamescope_enabled.help: Starts the game inside gamescope, in a window of its own. Upscaling and the frame limit below are optional. Gamescope must be installed.
settings.field.gamescope_enabled.label: Run in gamescope
settings.field.gog_saves.label: Save locations
settings.field.gpu.help: The card this game renders on, for computers with more than one. Works for OpenGL and Vulkan games, and DirectX games through DXVK and VKD3D-Proton.
settings.field.gpu.label: Graphics card
settings.field.hide_window_on_protocol_l: Games started from launch links or desktop shortcuts do not open the window.
settings.field.ignore_game_updates.help: Don't check for or offer updates for this game.
settings.field.ignore_game_updates.label: Ignore updates
settings.field.sandbox_no_network.label: Block the network
settings.field.sandbox_no_network.help: Runs the game in a bubblewrap sandbox without the internet, the local network or the programs listening on this computer. Online play and store features inside the game stop working.
settings.field.sandbox_no_home.label: Hide the home folder
settings.field.sandbox_no_home.help: Runs the game in a bubblewrap sandbox that sees only its install folder, its Wine prefix and a home folder of its own, where its saves and settings stay. Your files and other drives are hidden.
settings.field.language.help: Two- or four-letter code such as “fr” or “pt-BR”. Leave empty to use the interface language.
settings.field.language.label: Game language
settings.field.launcher_args.help: Appended to the game's command line.
settings.field.launcher_args.label: Game arguments
settings.field.library_top_section.label: Above the library
settings.field.lsfg_enabled.help: Adds generated frames with lsfg-vk and Lossless Scaling from Steam. For Vulkan games, and DirectX games through DXVK and VKD3D-Proton; not OpenGL. Your own lsfg-vk profiles are left alone.
settings.field.lsfg_enabled.label: Lossless Scaling frame generation
settings.field.lsfg_flow_scale.help: Resolution that motion is estimated at. Lower is faster, with more artefacts around moving edges.
settings.field.lsfg_flow_scale.label: Flow scale
settings.field.lsfg_multiplier.help: Frames shown for every frame the game renders. 2× doubles the frame rate.
settings.field.lsfg_multiplier.label: Frame multiplier
settings.field.lsfg_performance_mode.hel: A lighter model that costs a little quality. Helps on slower graphics cards.
settings.field.max_download_speed.label: Download speed limit
settings.field.max_recent_games.label: Recent games to keep
settings.field.max_sharpness.label: FSR sharpness
settings.field.max_workers.help: Most download connections at once. 0 lets Irori measure what is fastest (up to 32); any other number is the most it will use.
settings.field.max_workers.label: Download workers
settings.field.minimize_on_launch.help: The window comes back when the game exits.
settings.field.minimize_on_launch.label: Minimize when a game starts
settings.field.no_tray_icon.label: Hide tray icon
settings.field.nvidia_prime.help: For laptops with NVIDIA Optimus or AMD switchable graphics.
settings.field.nvidia_prime.label: Use the discrete GPU
settings.field.nvidia_reflex.help: DirectX 11 and 12 games get Reflex whenever DXVK-NVAPI is on. This also turns it on for Vulkan games, through DXVK-NVAPI’s Reflex layer, which must be installed. The game must support Reflex.
settings.field.nvidia_reflex.label: NVIDIA Reflex in Vulkan games
settings.field.shader_cache_size.label: Shader cache size (GB)
settings.field.shader_cache_size.help: Room for the graphics driver’s shader cache, so games don’t compile their shaders again at every start. 0 keeps the driver’s own limit.
settings.field.offline_mode.help: Skip the online ownership check. Some games refuse to start offline.
settings.field.offline_mode.label: Run offline
settings.field.panel_artwork.help: Replace the store’s art for this game. Irori keeps your choices; the store never sees them.
settings.field.panel_artwork.label: Cover, background and logo
settings.field.panel_controllers.label: Connected controllers

settings.field.panel_egl_sync.label: Sync with Epic Games Launcher (EGL)
settings.field.panel_eos_overlay.help: Epic's in-game overlay for friends, achievements and purchases. Some Epic games need it.
settings.field.panel_eos_overlay.label: EOS overlay
settings.field.panel_sync_saves.help: Download or upload this game's saves right away.

settings.page.saves_description: Back up the saves of every game with Ludusavi.
settings.field.ludusavi_auto_backup.help: Ludusavi copies the saves when the game exits, after any cloud upload.

settings.field.panel_save_backups.label: Save backups

settings.field.ludusavi_path.label: Ludusavi program

settings.field.ludusavi_backup_path.help: Where Ludusavi keeps the backups Irori makes. Leave empty for the folder set in Ludusavi.
settings.field.panel_launch_presets.help: Named sets of variables, wrappers, gamescope, MangoHud, the Wine build and programs alongside. Applying one changes only the settings it holds; everything else keeps following the defaults.
settings.field.panel_launch_programs.hel: Start trainers, overlays, voice chat or scripts with the game. What they do goes into the game’s log.
settings.programs.error.delay: Enter a delay from 0 to 600 seconds
settings.programs.path_placeholder: A file, or a command such as discord
settings.programs.name_placeholder: Shown in the list and the game’s log
settings.programs.name: Name
settings.programs.in_prefix: Run in the game’s Wine prefix
settings.programs.in_prefix_help: For Windows programs: they run with the game’s Wine or Proton build and see the same drives and saves.
settings.programs.in_prefix_steam_help: For Windows programs: they run in the Proton prefix Steam made for this game, through protontricks-launch.
settings.programs.stop_with_game: Stop it when the game ends
settings.programs.inherited: These come from the game defaults. Changing them here gives this game a list of its own.
settings.presets.error.name: Name the preset
settings.presets.error.empty: There is nothing to save yet: no variables, wrappers, gamescope, MangoHud, Wine build or programs alongside are changed here.
settings.presets.remove.title: Delete the preset “{preset}”?

settings.presets.save_help_game: Save as preset keeps the launch settings this game changes, to apply to other games later.
settings.presets.save_help_defaults: Save as preset keeps the launch settings these defaults change from Irori’s own.
settings.presets.dialog.title: Apply “{preset}”

settings.presets.builtin.older_32_bit_ga: Four CPU cores and a short OpenGL extension list, which many games from before 2005 need to start.
settings.field.prefer_system_libs.help: Use the system's libraries instead of the ones shipped with the Wine build.
settings.field.prefer_system_libs.label: Prefer system libraries
settings.field.proton_feature.help: Needs a Proton build that supports it, such as Proton-CachyOS.
settings.field.saves_path.label: Save folder
settings.field.secret_saved_placeholder: Saved — type a new key to replace it
settings.field.show_fps.label: Show FPS (DXVK HUD)
settings.field.show_log_on_launch.help: Opens the game’s log beside the library and keeps following it.
settings.field.show_log_on_launch.label: Show the log when a game starts
settings.field.show_mangohud.help: Performance overlay. MangoHud must be installed.
settings.field.show_mangohud.label: MangoHud overlay
settings.field.show_store_amazon.label: Show Amazon Games
settings.field.show_store_epic.label: Show Epic Games
settings.field.show_store_gog.label: Show GOG

settings.field.target_exe.help: Run a different executable from the game's folder.

settings.field.ui_accent_color.label: Accent color
settings.field.ui_big_picture_scale.help: Makes Big Picture larger for TVs. Big Picture’s menu changes it too.
settings.field.ui_density.help: How closely the library packs covers and rows. Interface size scales everything instead.
settings.field.ui_density.label: Density
settings.field.ui_font_family.help: Any font installed on this computer. Each one in the list is shown in its own face.

settings.field.ui_system_accent.label: Use the system accent color
settings.field.ui_wallpaper_colors.help: Make the default theme from the colors these tools take from your wallpaper, and follow them each time it changes. A theme picked from the list keeps its own colors.

Empty means pywal’s colors.json, which wallust also writes with pywal’s templates. For matugen, choose the JSON file one of its templates writes.

settings.field.ui_tile_size.help: Width of game covers in the library grid.
settings.field.ui_tile_size.label: Cover size

settings.field.ui_translucency.label: Translucency
settings.field.use_game_mode.help: Let Feral GameMode tune the system while playing. GameMode must be installed.
settings.field.use_game_mode.label: GameMode
settings.field.verbose_logs.help: Write the game's output and debug information to its log.

settings.field.vkd3d_version.label: VKD3D-Proton version

settings.field.wine_prefix.label: Prefix
settings.field.wine_crossover_bottle.hel: Name of the bottle the game runs in when CrossOver is the Wine version. Create the bottle in CrossOver first.
settings.field.retina_mode.label: Retina mode
settings.field.retina_mode.help: Renders the game at your display’s full resolution instead of scaling it up. Sharper, but heavier on the graphics card, and some games then show a tiny interface.
settings.field.wine_version.label: Wine or Proton build
settings.field.wrapper_options.help: Programs that start the game, outermost first.
settings.field.wrapper_options.label: Wrapper commands
settings.field.xess_upgrade.label: Upgrade XeSS
settings.field.zoom_platform.label: ZOOM Platform store
settings.field.itch_io.label: itch.io store
settings.field.itch_io.help: Log in with an itch.io API key to install, update and play the games you own there.
settings.game.native_note: This game runs natively, so Wine and Proton settings don't apply to it.
settings.game.overridden_none: Uses the game defaults for everything.
settings.game.overridden_one: 1 setting differs from the game defaults.
settings.game.overridden_other: {count} settings differ from the game defaults.
settings.game.reset_all.description: Every setting of this game returns to the game defaults.
settings.game.reset_all.title: Reset settings of “{title}”?
settings.game.unknown.description: It may have been removed or its store is signed out.
settings.game.unknown.title: This game isn't in your library
settings.logs.follow_tooltip: Follow new lines as they are written
settings.logs.truncated: Showing the end of the file. The full log is at {path}
settings.logs.upload.description: The log is sent to dpaste.com. Anyone with the link can read it for 2 days.
settings.logs.upload.title: Upload this log?
settings.needs.linux_mac: Only on Linux. On macOS, the system manages graphics cards itself.
settings.needs.linux_windows: Only on Linux. On Windows, choose a game’s graphics card in Settings › System › Display › Graphics.
settings.needs.lossless_scaling: Install Lossless Scaling from Steam and switch it to its “lsfg-vk” branch
settings.needs.lsfg_update: Update lsfg-vk to version 2 or newer
settings.needs.no_chosen_gpu: A graphics card is chosen above
settings.needs.nvidia: Needs an NVIDIA graphics card running NVIDIA’s driver
settings.needs.rtx_40: Needs a GeForce RTX 40 series card or newer
settings.needs.several_gpus: Only one graphics card was found
settings.needs.windows_game: Native Linux games use Reflex without help
settings.page.advanced_description: Store tools, artwork, Epic Games, Wine, diagnostics and maintenance.
settings.page.backup_description: Back up on a schedule or to a file, sync your library between computers, or export your game list.
settings.page.game_defaults_description: Every game uses these launch settings unless its own settings override them.
settings.page.general_description: Folders, updates, tray behaviour, integrations, downloads and controllers.
settings.page.logs_description: Irori's own log. Each game's log is in its settings.
settings.page.storage_description: What your games and Irori’s tools take on each disk, and what can be freed safely.
settings.page.system_info_description: Include this when you report a problem.
settings.pairs.wrapper_hint: Quote arguments that contain spaces, e.g. --config "/path/with spaces".
settings.preview.background_no_picture: Choose a picture to show it behind the library.
settings.preview.background_off_transpar: The background stays off while your system asks for less transparency.
settings.preview.sample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
settings.requires.controller_navigation: Turn controller navigation back on first
settings.requires.dxvk_nvapi: Turn on automatic DXVK-NVAPI installation first
settings.requires.fps_limit: Turn on the frame rate limit first
settings.requires.gamescope_limiter: Turn on the gamescope limiter first
settings.requires.lsfg: Turn on Lossless Scaling frame generation first
settings.requires.vkd3d: Turn on automatic VKD3D install first
settings.requires.wallpaper_colors: Turn on colors from pywal, wallust or matugen first
settings.reset_settings.description: Every setting, including each game's settings, returns to its default. Accounts and installed games are kept.
settings.reset_settings.title: Reset all settings?
settings.saves.direction.label: Sync direction
settings.saves.force_download.descriptio: The cloud copy overwrites the saves on this computer.
settings.saves.force_download.title: Replace the local saves of “{title}”?
settings.saves.force_upload.description: The saves on this computer overwrite the cloud copy.
settings.saves.force_upload.title: Replace the cloud saves of “{title}”?
settings.saves.unavailable.game: This game doesn't use cloud saves.
settings.saves.unavailable.not_installed: Install the game to sync its saves.
settings.saves.unavailable.offline: You're offline. Sync again once you're connected.
settings.saves.unavailable.store: This store doesn't offer cloud saves.
settings.saves.unavailable.unknown_game: This game isn't in your library.
settings.search.empty_hint: Try another word, such as “tray”, “fps” or “prefix”.
settings.storage.cleanup.art_cache.confi: The thumbnails are deleted and made again from the downloaded art when shown.
settings.storage.cleanup.art_cache.descr: Resized covers and backdrops. Irori makes them again as it shows them.
settings.storage.cleanup.art_cache.title: Art thumbnails
settings.storage.cleanup.download_leftov: These files are deleted. An unfinished install downloads again from the start.
Partly downloaded files no download will finish, installs that never finished, and launcher installers already used.
settings.storage.cleanup.logs.confirm_de: These logs are deleted, so they can’t be attached to a bug report afterwards.
settings.storage.cleanup.logs.descriptio: Game, install and older Irori logs. The current Irori log stays.
settings.storage.cleanup.logs.title: Logs
settings.storage.cleanup.orphan_prefixes: These prefixes are deleted with everything in them, saves included.
Prefixes in your prefix folder that no installed game or launcher uses.
Some games keep their saves only in their prefix. Choose a prefix only if you don’t need its saves or they are in the cloud.
settings.storage.cleanup.unused_wine_bui: These builds are removed. You can download them again from the Wine manager.
Builds Irori downloaded that no game uses, where a newer build of the same kind is installed.
settings.storage.no_disks: Irori found nothing of its own on a disk it can read.
settings.tools.dx.help: Install or remove it in this game's prefix now. Proton ships its own.
settings.reshade.label: ReShade
settings.reshade.help: Post-processing effects such as sharpening, colour and lighting. Irori downloads ReShade from reshade.me with its standard shaders and installs them into the game folder.
settings.reshade.unsupported: ReShade can be added to Windows games that Irori installed.
settings.reshade.installed_help: Installed as {dll} for {api}, beside {program}. Press Home in the game to open ReShade.
settings.reshade.wine_note: When the game starts, Irori tells Wine to load {dlls} from the game folder.
settings.reshade.incomplete: The last install didn’t finish. Remove it, then install again.
settings.reshade.remove.title: Remove ReShade from “{title}”?
settings.reshade.remove.description: Irori deletes the files it installed that are unchanged. ReShade.ini, your presets and files you changed stay in the game folder.
settings.reshade.anticheat.title: Install ReShade for “{title}”?
settings.reshade.anticheat.description: “{title}” uses {anticheat}. Anticheat can block ReShade or ban accounts that use it, so only play online with it if the game allows it.
settings.reshade.error.banned: ReShade’s compatibility list says {program} blocks or bans ReShade, so Irori won’t install it.
settings.reshade.error.no_api: Irori couldn’t tell which program draws the game. Choose the game’s program and try again.
settings.reshade.error.unsupported: The game draws with {api}, which Irori can’t install ReShade for.
settings.reshade.error.arch: ReShade has no build for the game’s processor.
settings.reshade.error.dll_taken: {file} is already in the game folder and isn’t ReShade’s, so Irori left it alone. Another mod or DXVK may have put it there.
settings.reshade.error.outside: Choose a program inside the game folder.
settings.tools.kill_prefix.help: End every program still running in the prefix.
settings.tools.kill_prefix.label: Stop prefix processes
settings.tools.run_exe.help: Start an installer or other Windows program in the game's prefix.
settings.tools.run_exe.label: Run a program
settings.tools.windows_only: Only Windows games use a Wine prefix.
settings.tools.winecfg.help: Change Windows version, drives and audio of the prefix.
settings.tools.winecfg.label: Wine configuration
settings.tools.winetricks.help: Open Winetricks' own window for everything the list below doesn't cover.
settings.tools.winetricks.label: Winetricks
settings.validate.args_command_syntax: Steam's %command% syntax doesn't work here; enter only the arguments.
settings.validate.args_env_vars: Set environment variables in the list below instead.
settings.validate.discord_id: A Discord application ID is a 17–20 digit number; copy it from your application's General Information page.
settings.validate.save_location_empty: Enter both a name and a folder
settings.wine.none_found: No Wine or Proton builds found. Download one in the Wine manager.
settings.wine.searching: Looking for Wine and Proton builds…
settings.winetricks.error.timeout: Winetricks took too long to list its components
settings.winetricks.showing: Showing {shown} of {total}. Search to narrow the list.
settings.field.action_import_lutris.help: Bring over installed games, emulated games, favourites, categories and playtime from Lutris. Lutris itself is left untouched.
settings.field.file_achievements.label: Read achievements from game files
settings.field.file_achievements.help: For games Irori starts from their own program, read the unlocks that Steam API emulators such as Goldberg keep with the game. Names and icons come from Steam.
settings.field.steam_app_id.label: Steam app id
settings.field.steam_app_id.help: The Steam game these achievements belong to, used while “Read achievements from game files” is on. Leave it empty to find it in the game’s files.
settings.field.panel_replay.label: Recorder
settings.field.replay_enabled.label: Keep a replay buffer
settings.field.replay_enabled.help: While the game runs, gpu-screen-recorder keeps the last moments ready to save as a clip.
settings.field.replay_seconds.label: Clip length
settings.field.replay_quality.label: Quality
settings.field.replay_quality.help: Higher quality makes larger clips and takes more memory while you play.
settings.field.replay_audio.label: Sound
settings.field.replay_capture.label: Record
settings.field.replay_capture.help: The whole screen needs no questions. On a Wayland desktop that refuses it, let the desktop ask once what to record.
settings.field.replay_folder.label: Clips folder
settings.requires.replay: Turn on the replay buffer first
settings.replay.missing_help: Irori records with it and never bundles it. Install it from Flathub or your distribution’s packages, then refresh.
settings.replay.ways: Save a clip while you play
settings.replay.way_controller: Controller: hold Guide and press X (Square on PlayStation)
settings.replay.way_menus: Tray menu or command palette (Ctrl+K): Save clip
settings.replay.shortcut_bound: Keyboard: {keys}. Change it in your desktop’s shortcut settings.
settings.replay.shortcut_bound_unnamed: Keyboard: set up. Change the keys in your desktop’s shortcut settings.
settings.replay.shortcut_unassigned: Keyboard: the shortcut has no keys yet. Assign them in your desktop’s shortcut settings.
settings.replay.shortcut_off: Keyboard: ask your desktop for a shortcut that works while the game has focus.
settings.replay.shortcut_unavailable: Keyboard: your desktop has no global shortcuts, so keys pressed in a game can’t reach Irori. Use the controller, the tray or the command palette.
settings.replay.memory: Holding {seconds} seconds takes about {size} MB of memory while a game runs.
settings.replay.clips_in: Clips go to {folder}, in a folder per game.
settings.field.action_import_bottles.hel: Adds the programs of every bottle, and the games installed into them, with the bottle as their prefix. Bottles itself is left untouched.
settings.field.action_import_faugus.help: Adds Faugus Launcher’s games with their prefix, Proton build, variables and arguments. Faugus Launcher itself is left untouched.
settings.field.action_import_playnite.he: Adds Playnite’s installed games with their covers, backgrounds, playtime, favourites and categories; Playnite starts them. Games of Steam, Epic Games, GOG and the other stores Irori lists are matched instead of added twice. Close Playnite first; it is left untouched.
settings.field.action_open_windows_files: Double-click an .exe, .msi, .bat or .reg file to open it in the Wine prefix of a game you choose. Irori replaces the program that opens these files now, such as Wine.
settings.windows_files.done: Windows programs now open with Irori
settings.windows_files.failed: Couldn't make Irori the program for Windows files
settings.field.achievement_notices.label: Announce new achievements
settings.field.achievement_notices.help: While a game runs, Irori checks its achievements every few minutes (every minute for ones kept in the game’s files) and shows each unlock as a notification over the game, then once more when it closes.
settings.field.start_with_system.label: Start with the system
settings.field.start_with_system.help: Opens Irori when you log in to your computer.
settings.field.start_with_system_minimiz: Start in the tray when starting with the system
When Irori opens at login, it waits in the tray instead of showing its window.
settings.steam_compat.heading: Steam Play
settings.steam_compat.label: Compatibility tool
settings.steam_compat.help: The Proton build Steam runs this game with. Irori changes only this game's choice in Steam's settings.
settings.steam_compat.running: Steam is running and overwrites its settings when it exits, so Irori asks to close it before saving a new choice.
settings.steam_compat.session: Steam runs this session, so change the tool in the game's properties in Steam.
settings.steam_compat.none_found: No compatibility tools found. Steam installs Proton when a game first needs it, and Proton builds from the Wine manager appear here when “Install Proton downloads into Steam” is on.
settings.steam_compat.footer: Steam uses the new choice from its next start. Before each change Irori keeps the previous settings file as config.vdf.irori-backup.
settings.steam_compat.load_failed: Steam's compatibility tools couldn't be read
settings.steam_compat.saved_default: Steam will run “{title}” with its default tool
settings.steam_compat.close.title: Close Steam to change “{title}”?
settings.steam_compat.close.description: Steam closes, along with any game it is running, and Irori then switches to {tool}. Playing the game starts Steam again.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.none: ProtonDB has no rating for this game yet.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.native: Native: the game has a Linux version, so it needs no compatibility tool.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.platinum: Platinum: runs perfectly out of the box. Steam's default should do.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.gold: Gold: runs perfectly after tweaks. The reports say which.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.silver: Silver: runs with minor issues. A newer Proton or GE-Proton may help.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.bronze: Bronze: runs, but often with problems. Try Proton Experimental or GE-Proton.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.borked: Borked: reported not to run. Read the reports before trying another tool.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.pending: Pending: too few reports for a rating yet.
settings.field.ui_cover_categories.label: Show categories on covers
settings.field.ui_cover_categories.help: Each game’s categories along the foot of its cover in the grid, the first two and how many more.
settings.field.ui_group_copies.label: Show copies from several stores as one game
settings.field.ui_group_copies.help: A game owned on Steam, Epic Games and GOG shows once, playing the installed copy. Its page switches between the copies; each keeps its own playtime and achievements.
settings.field.xbox.label: Xbox store
settings.field.xbox.help: Sign in with a Microsoft account to install and play your Microsoft Store and PC Game Pass games. They run through the Nexus Runtime from the Wine manager.
settings.field.xbox_market.label: Microsoft Store region
settings.field.xbox_market.help: Two-letter country code (US, DE, GB…) for the library, catalog and licences. Empty follows the interface language.
settings.field.xbox_market.off: Turn on the Xbox store first.
